# SellerHisab Copilot Instructions

Before changing code, read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`, and `docs/AI_WORKLOG.md`.

The repository/current branch is the source of truth. Do not rely on stale chat history when it conflicts with repository evidence.

At the end of meaningful work, update `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md` and append a concise entry to `docs/AI_WORKLOG.md` including changed files, tests actually run, commit/push/deploy status, unresolved items, and the exact next action.

Follow all production-safety and engineering rules in `AGENTS.md`.
